previous_statement: Diagonal amplification: for the operator-algebra matrix norm, ||I_n tensor u_P||=||u_P|| for every n, so the level-one estimate gives ||U||<=K_u uniformly in n.
new_statement: Direct amplified unit bound (no diagonal-isometry assumption): the registered extended epsilon-C*-norm axioms and compressed-product display, together with lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action, give universal K_u<infinity and e_u>0 such that U=I_n tensor u_P satisfies ||U||<=K_u for every n and every H-CB datum with e<=e_u.
